in_hebrew.name: Germaun
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Germaun הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Germaun is derived from the Old German words 'ger' meaning spear and 'man' meaning ruler or leader. This name was common among Germanic tribes and was borne by several early Christian saints. Germaun may evoke images of strength and leadership, and is a fitting choice for a son.
